title: Define type-specific task lifecycle status contracts
objective: Make task lifecycle status type-specific and schema-declared, keep it distinct from envelope processingStatus and result outcome status, conditionally validate result fields by task status, document every x-sdlc-* convention, migrate existing task records, and release the breaking pre-1.0 schema change as a minor version.

branch.name: WI-0034-task-lifecycle-status
branch.rationale: The task contract and validator changes are breaking schema changes and must be processed on a dedicated context branch before the pre-1.0 minor release is prepared on the primary branch.

request.text: Define type-specific task lifecycle status contracts distinct from envelope processingStatus and result outcome status; require every task contract to declare its own status, add declarative conditional result validation, document all x-sdlc-* schema conventions in schemas/README.md, migrate existing task records, and release the pre-1.0 breaking schema change as a minor version.

scope.name: processing-and-task-lifecycle-separation
scope.description: Preserve envelope processingStatus as the host processing boundary and define task.status as the selected task type lifecycle boundary.
scope.reason: Processing completion and task completion are different facts and must not be conflated.

scope.name: type-specific-task-status-contracts
scope.description: Require a root status field in every task-specific contract with a task-specific enum, descriptions, and lifecycle semantics.
scope.reason: Each task kind has different milestones, blockers, gates, and terminal conditions.

scope.name: declarative-result-requirements
scope.description: Declare status-dependent result and result-field requirements in task schemas using documented x-sdlc-* metadata interpreted by generic validation code.
scope.reason: Adding or changing a task contract should update conditional validation without adding task-type branches to the validator.

scope.name: schema-convention-documentation
scope.description: Add schemas/README.md documenting every x-sdlc-* convention, schema annotation, registry behavior, and interpretation rule.
scope.reason: Schema metadata is executable contract information and must have one durable authoring and consumer guide.

scope.name: persisted-record-migration
scope.description: Audit and migrate existing task records and examples to the new type-specific lifecycle status contract without confusing result.status values with task.status.
scope.reason: The new required field is a breaking change to all persisted task envelopes.

scope.name: pre-v1-minor-release
scope.description: Release the breaking schema and validator change as a minor package version under the repository pre-1.0 compatibility policy.
scope.reason: The public schema contract changes, but the package remains below 1.0.0.

nonGoals.name: processing-status-redesign
nonGoals.description: Do not change the meaning or vocabulary of envelope processingStatus.
nonGoals.reason: The host processing boundary already has a separate responsibility.

nonGoals.name: result-outcome-collapse
nonGoals.description: Do not remove or rename task-specific result.status fields or treat them as replacements for task lifecycle status.
nonGoals.reason: Result outcomes describe observations; task status describes lifecycle.

nonGoals.name: semantic-approval
nonGoals.description: Do not infer approval, production readiness, or successful target behavior solely from task.status: complete.
nonGoals.reason: A finalized validation or review task may record a failed, blocked, or rejected outcome.

items.name: task-contract-status-required
items.description: Every task-specific contract must require a root status field in addition to intent and result, and the selected contract must own the allowed status values.
items.reason: Task lifecycle vocabulary cannot be safely represented by one generic envelope enum because each task type has different milestones and terminal conditions.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The decomposition, research, decision, design, implementation, test-strategy, validation, review, rework, and delivery schemas each require status, intent, and result at their task-contract root.

The envelope continues to require task.status but generic envelope validation does not reject a valid status solely because it belongs to a different task type; selected task-schema validation rejects unknown type-specific statuses.

items.name: lifecycle-status-separation
items.description: The implementation must preserve distinct meanings for envelope processingStatus, task lifecycle status, and task-specific result status.
items.reason: A processing-completed envelope can contain a planned task, and a complete validation task can record a failed validation result.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Documentation and tests demonstrate processingStatus, task.status, and result.status with distinct values and meanings.
Validation never derives task lifecycle status from processingStatus or result.status.

items.name: declarative-conditional-results
items.description: Each task schema must declare status-dependent result and result-field requirements through documented x-sdlc-* metadata, and generic validation must interpret that metadata without task-type-specific branches.
items.reason: Incomplete tasks must persist with absent, null, empty, or partial results while finalized task statuses must enforce the appropriate task-specific result contract.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Schemas declare which result paths are required for each lifecycle status, including any task-specific milestone and terminal requirements.
Tests cover omitted, null, empty, partial, invalid, and fully populated results across representative task statuses and task types.

items.name: schema-metadata-documentation
items.description: schemas/README.md must document every x-sdlc-* convention, its allowed location and shape, its consumer, its interpretation, its validation behavior, and the process for adding a new convention.
items.reason: Undocumented schema metadata creates hidden validator behavior and makes future schema extensions unsafe.

acceptanceCriteria.description: schemas/README.md documents x-sdlc-reference-type, x-sdlc-task-lifecycle, x-field-role, lifecycle metadata paths, unknown metadata handling, and ordinary JSON Schema precedence.
A dynamic documentation/audit test fails when an x-sdlc-* metadata key is introduced without corresponding README coverage.

items.name: migration-and-release
items.description: All persisted task records, examples, tests, validator projections, and schema references must be migrated and the breaking pre-1.0 change released as a minor version.
items.reason: The new required task status invalidates existing task contracts unless every persisted record is updated consistently.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every existing task envelope has a valid task-type lifecycle status and remains distinct from its result status.
Typecheck, build, complete tests, schema audit, representative CLI validation, and WI-0034 validation pass before the minor release is prepared.

versionSuggestion.rationale: Introduces required type-specific task lifecycle status fields, declarative result validation metadata, schema documentation, persisted-record migration, and a pre-1.0 minor release boundary.
versionSuggestion.disclaimer: This is an inferred recommendation; retain the minor impact unless the final implementation changes compatibility policy beyond the planned pre-1.0 schema break.
